criteria.requirement: Every listed artifact hash matches the reviewed bytes.
The revision changes only the installer diagnostic and evidence boundary; capability actions, permissions, resources, triggers, owner, and project binding are not expanded.
A failure is persisted before rollback and the rollback result is appended afterward.
Structured checks retain bounded expected and observed values; unclassified failures do not export arbitrary exception bodies, stdout, stderr, tracebacks, or environment dumps.
CI evidence is a closed projection and prohibits transaction tokens, secrets, nonce values, passwords, credentials, authorization material, and raw private payloads.

The admitted repair is limited to inspecting the exact final shortcut bytes through a hash-equal ASCII-path projection; it does not rename the visible Unicode shortcut or weaken activation assertions.
The S09 path expansion adds only the existing canonical shortcut inspector to the same diagnostic Owner and does not authorize local candidate installation before S14.
The deterministic admission inspection has no trigger conflict, call cycle, resource conflict, or binding error.

verdict_rule: PASS only when C01-C08 all pass; otherwise FAIL or INCONCLUSIVE with criterion-specific evidence.
